Both limits must be finite integers or floats other than booleans. `moisture_limit` must lie from 0 through 100 inclusive. Incorrect types raise `TypeError`; non-finite or out-of-range values raise `ValueError`.

The method `observe(sample)` accepts a dictionary with `temperature` and `humidity` fields. Their values must be finite integers or floats other than booleans, and humidity must be between 0 and 100 inclusive. Additional fields are ignored. Validate the sample fully before changing any state.

A fan is on exactly when temperature is strictly greater than `temp_limit` or humidity is strictly greater than `moisture_limit`. Each successful observation returns a new dictionary with keys, in this order: `sequence`, `temperature`, `humidity`, `fan_on`, and `reasons`. Sequence numbers start at 1. `reasons` is a tuple containing `temperature` first when its limit was exceeded and `humidity` second when its limit was exceeded.

The method `history()` returns a deep copy of all result dictionaries in observation order. Neither input samples nor returned values may alias internal history, and invalid observations must not increment the sequence or alter fan state. The read-only `fan_on` property exposes the current state, initially `False`.

import math
import unittest

from solution import VentilationMonitor


class VentilationMonitorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_limit_validation(self):
        for temp in (True, "20", None, math.inf, math.nan):
            exc = TypeError if isinstance(temp, (bool, str)) or temp is None else ValueError
            with self.subTest(temp=temp):
                with self.assertRaises(exc):
                    VentilationMonitor(temp, 50)
        for moisture in (True, "50", None, math.inf, math.nan, -0.1, 100.1):
            exc = TypeError if isinstance(moisture, (bool, str)) or moisture is None else ValueError
            with self.subTest(moisture=moisture):
                with self.assertRaises(exc):
                    VentilationMonitor(20, moisture)
        VentilationMonitor(-100.5, 0)
        VentilationMonitor(100, 100)

    def test_observations_order_reasons_and_strict_limits(self):
        monitor = VentilationMonitor(25, 60)
        self.assertFalse(monitor.fan_on)
        exact = monitor.observe({"temperature": 25, "humidity": 60, "ignored": object()})
        self.assertEqual(list(exact), ["sequence", "temperature", "humidity", "fan_on", "reasons"])
        self.assertEqual(exact, {
            "sequence": 1, "temperature": 25, "humidity": 60,
            "fan_on": False, "reasons": ()
        })
        both = monitor.observe({"temperature": 26.5, "humidity": 61})
        self.assertEqual(both["sequence"], 2)
        self.assertTrue(both["fan_on"])
        self.assertEqual(both["reasons"], ("temperature", "humidity"))
        humidity = monitor.observe({"temperature": 20, "humidity": 100})
        self.assertEqual(humidity["reasons"], ("humidity",))
        self.assertTrue(monitor.fan_on)
        cool = monitor.observe({"temperature": -5, "humidity": 0})
        self.assertFalse(cool["fan_on"])
        self.assertFalse(monitor.fan_on)

    def test_input_and_results_do_not_alias_history(self):
        monitor = VentilationMonitor(10, 20)
        sample = {"temperature": 11, "humidity": 5, "nested": [1]}
        result = monitor.observe(sample)
        sample["temperature"] = -100
        result["temperature"] = 999
        result["reasons"] = ("changed",)
        history = monitor.history()
        self.assertEqual(history[0]["temperature"], 11)
        self.assertEqual(history[0]["reasons"], ("temperature",))
        history[0]["temperature"] = 500
        history.append({})
        again = monitor.history()
        self.assertEqual(len(again), 1)
        self.assertEqual(again[0]["temperature"], 11)
        self.assertIsNot(history, again)

    def test_invalid_samples_are_atomic(self):
        monitor = VentilationMonitor(10, 50)
        monitor.observe({"temperature": 20, "humidity": 40})
        self.assertTrue(monitor.fan_on)
        baseline = monitor.history()
        cases = [
            (None, TypeError),
            ([], TypeError),
            ({"humidity": 20}, TypeError),
            ({"temperature": 20}, TypeError),
            ({"temperature": True, "humidity": 20}, TypeError),
            ({"temperature": 20, "humidity": False}, TypeError),
            ({"temperature": "20", "humidity": 20}, TypeError),
            ({"temperature": math.inf, "humidity": 20}, ValueError),
            ({"temperature": 20, "humidity": math.nan}, ValueError),
            ({"temperature": 20, "humidity": -1}, ValueError),
            ({"temperature": 20, "humidity": 101}, ValueError),
        ]
        for sample, exc in cases:
            with self.subTest(sample=sample):
                with self.assertRaises(exc):
                    monitor.observe(sample)
                self.assertEqual(monitor.history(), baseline)
                self.assertTrue(monitor.fan_on)
        next_result = monitor.observe({"temperature": 0, "humidity": 0})
        self.assertEqual(next_result["sequence"], 2)

    def test_fan_property_is_read_only(self):
        monitor = VentilationMonitor(1, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            monitor.fan_on = True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
